title: Dev not sending TBR to NS
symptom: After migrating from Master to Dev, Nightscout no longer shows TBR (temporary basal rate) treatments. The NSClient queue grows to +1500 items, and the TBR data in the log is stuck at the time of the Dev installation, while other data like SMBs and device status are sent.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify a root cause, but the issue was resolved by resetting the phone's database, suggesting a database state issue.
fix: Reset the database on the phone via the Maintenance menu / "Reset Databases" button. After resetting, the loop started again and TBRs were sent to NS.
evidence_quote: resetting the database on the phone, via the Maintenance menu/ "Reset Databases" button did the trick. After 20 mins of new BGs the loop started again and TBRs are now sent to NS.
